The other is an umpire (E1), clearly associated with baseball through multiple sources (D2S1, D3S4, D4S3, D5S1). Both associations are valid and non-conflicting. 'Major League Baseball' (C2) is a specific subset of baseball and does not contradict the broader association already included.
